messages:
Erin: Found a tiny hoodie in the lost-and-found. It has a hand-stitched gnome face. Who's missing a hoodie-sized gnome? :mage:
Devon: That is officially the cutest evidence of late-night debugging. I nominate the gnome as our new micro-mascot.
Hao: Is there an origin story? Did someone knit a mascot for the CI pipeline?
Sofia: Backstory: I may have made it during an all-hands when the WiFi went down. It was therapeutic.
Luca: Thread of destiny. Tiny Hoodie Gnome (THG) should have a shrine next to the snack shelf. Minimal maintenance required.
Erin: SnackBot: FYI if the gnome is placed near the snack shelf, please do not deploy sticky cereal as offering.
SnackBot: Acknowledged. Suggested offerings: one single almond, a crumb-free note, or a tiny post-it haiku.
Devon: Can we formalize: THG gets a weekly badge in #random and a one-line lore update on Fridays?
PeopleOps: Cute idea. If this becomes a recurring micro-tradition, we'll add a short blurb to the culture guide and coordinate small budget for a tiny scarf.
Hao: I propose the THG acceptance speech: "I am but a hoodie, warmed by CPU and empathy."
Sofia: Also propose a smock for the gnome when someone opens the snack cupboard in dramatic fashion.
Luca: Important logistics: does THG get a Slack emoji? I demand a :hoodie-gnome: emoji.
Erin: Emoji request approved pending cafeteria council. We'll vote via reactions.
Devon: Voting now. :thumbsup: for shrine by snack shelf, :heart: for shrine on front-desk, :laughing: for shrine inside meeting room B.
Hao: Also small governance: who is permitted to move the THG? Rule suggestion: only holders of the "Tiny Custodian" title, granted by majority emoji vote.
Sofia: I'm drafting the Tiny Custodian bylaws. Article I: No glitter. Article II: No naps in the gnome's hoodie. Article III: ceremonial bobble permitted.
Luca: PeopleOps: will the custodianship be recognized on the org chart or just in myth?
PeopleOps: Myth first, org chart later. We'll create a one-line entry in the culture handbook and a tiny GIF for the gnome's onboarding.
Erin: Photo ops tomorrow 10:15. Bring scarves and dignity. We'll take the official portrait for the emoji.
Devon: Also, someone should write a short fable. Working title: "The Gnome Who Debugged at Midnight."
Hao: Haiku submission: "Hoodie guards the crumbs / Quiet watcher of snack wars / Small stitches, big heart"
Sofia: Love it. Also: SnackBot, can you log THG offerings? For historical record.
SnackBot: Logging offering: one almond, a sticky note, and three grateful smiles. Logged under #culture-gnome.
Luca: If anyone steals the gnome, we auto-assign them a week of dish duty and public apology in #random. Deterrent established.
Erin: Final note: tiny hoodie lives in lost-and-found until the portrait tomorrow. Bring tiny props. If anyone wants to volunteer as Tiny Custodian candidate, drop your manifesto (<=3 lines).
Devon: Manifesto: "I vow to keep the hoodie lint-free and to read gnome haikus aloud on solemn Tuesday mornings."
Hao: Manifesto: "I will ensure the gnome never faces the copier. Copiers are bad influence"
Sofia: Manifesto: "I will defend the shrine during snack rush hour and bring occasional tiny scarves."
PeopleOps: We'll announce the official Tiny Custodian election after the portrait. Thank you for keeping culture cozy.
Erin: See you tomorrow. Long live the Tiny Hoodie Gnome. :mage::hoodie:
